claim_boundary: The audit proves that retaining the complete tape would materially erode the 18-qubit forward capacity margin.
The provider interface and small distributed rematerialization path are implemented and numerically validated.
A dependency-aware partial-mesh rematerialization engine is implemented and validated on a controlled distributed DAG.
Per-target memory-budgeted scheduling is implemented; joint checkpoint selection across the complete reverse schedule is not.
The subsequent 18-qubit reverse-capacity execution is recorded separately in reverse_capacity_breakthrough_20260729.json.
No large-scale reverse-capacity success claim is made.
